items.title: Louis Armstrong: Jazz Casual Interview, 1964-07-10
items.q: R. Rainey had been singing a long time. Became a set gal, you know. Good woman.

ctx.x: Did Bessie come from R. Rainey? Is that where she came from as a singer?
Well, I don't know who was first. R. Rainey had been singing a long time. Became a set gal, you know. Good woman. Yeah, I think Bessie came a little later and out sang them all.
